Container.Name: jf-dispatch-scheduler
Container.Overview: Capability-aware distributed FFmpeg scheduler for Jellyfin. Run this scheduler on Unraid and connect Linux amd64/arm64 workers over Tailscale.
Container.Requires: Unraid host must be connected to the same Tailscale network as the workers. Allow worker-to-scheduler TCP 7000 and scheduler-to-worker TCP 7100.

Config.Name: Cluster token
Config.Description: Shared secret used by the scheduler, wrapper, and every worker. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32

Config.Name: Scheduler address
Config.Description: Tailscale MagicDNS name or 100.x address that clients use to reach this scheduler.

Config.Name: Scheduler listen address
Config.Description: gRPC listen address inside the host-networked container.

Config.Name: Metrics listen address
Config.Description: Health and Prometheus endpoint listen address.

Config.Name: Media
Config.Description: Media path. Workers must mount the same content at /media.

Config.Name: Transcode
Config.Description: Shared transcode directory. Workers must mount the same content at /transcode.
